details: Bitcoin extended its strong rally, breaking above the $84,000 mark and setting a new recent high, while Ethereum strengthened in tandem, reclaiming $2,700. This continuous rally in the two major cryptocurrencies has driven a clear recovery in digital asset market sentiment, fueled by favorable regulatory developments, rebounding institutional inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs, and significant short-position liquidations. The cumulative market capitalization of all crypto assets has added $70 billion in a day.
title: Bitcoin Tops $84K, Ethereum Crosses $2,700 as Crypto Market Rallies

details: Despite the U.S. Senate's recent vote against advancing the CLARITY Act, U.S. regulatory bodies are moving forward with crypto-related actions under their existing authority. The SEC has introduced a five-year innovation exemption for tokenized U.S. stocks, allowing qualifying venues to trade them on blockchain-based platforms without traditional exchange registration. Concurrently, the CFTC formally submitted its crypto market-structure rulemaking to the White House Office of Management and Budget for review, indicating that regulatory certainty is being established through agency action rather than legislative processes.
title: SEC & CFTC Advance Crypto Regulations Despite CLARITY Act Setback

details: Solana has emerged as a top performer, posting significant gains of over 8% in the short term and climbing to $115. This strong performance is part of a broader altcoin rally, with other assets like BNB and XRP also seeing positive movement. In a major ecosystem development, ZetaChain holders have voted to shut down their Layer 1 network and move the ZETA token to the Solana blockchain.
title: Solana Leads Altcoin Gains; ZetaChain to Migrate to Solana

details: The Pepeto project has announced that multiple exchange listings are in the pipeline, with a Binance debut expected soon, attracting significant attention and over $11 million in its raise. Separately, Grok AI, developed by Elon Musk's xAI, has mapped an ambitious XRP price prediction, suggesting the token could reach between $5 and $8 before the end of 2026, driven by factors such as live spot ETFs and the CLARITY Act (despite its recent legislative setback).
title: Pepeto Announces Exchange Listings, XRP Price Predicted to Hit $8
